sections.title: Myself and Good Habits
sections.explanation: Know your name, age, class and school. Good habits and manners make home and school happier. Saying please, thank you and sorry is a superpower for Grade 2 kids in India.
points: Say please, thank you and sorry
Share toys; wait for your turn

examples.title: Manners
examples.problem: Someone lends you a pencil. What do you say?

examples.title: Home
examples.problem: You bump into your sibling. What do you say?

sections.title: Our India (Basics)
sections.explanation: India is our country. New Delhi is the capital. We have many languages, foods and festivals. Knowing a few facts about India builds pride and curiosity for Grade 2 learners.

examples.title: Capital
examples.problem: Capital of India?

examples.title: Flag
examples.problem: Our national flag is also called?

sections.title: National Symbols
sections.explanation: National symbols are special signs of India. Learn the flag, animal, bird, flower and fruit at kid level. Respect the flag during assembly and never let it touch the ground carelessly.
points: Anthem: Jana Gana Mana — stand quietly

examples.title: Bird
examples.problem: National bird of India?

examples.title: Fruit
examples.problem: National fruit of India?

sections.title: Animals Around Us
sections.explanation: Animals live on land, in water and in the air. Pets need care; wild animals need safe forests. Indian children may see cows, dogs, sparrows, elephants in stories and sometimes peacocks in parks.
points: Pets: dog, cat, fish — feed and be gentle
Do not tease animals; ask adults before touching

sections.title: Famous Indians (Kid Level)
sections.explanation: Some Indians are remembered for helping people and our country. Mahatma Gandhi taught truth and non-violence. Teachers and doctors are everyday heroes. We can be helpful in small ways too.
points: Teachers — help us learn every day
Doctors and nurses — keep us healthy
Freedom fighters and helpers — be brave and kind

examples.title: Gandhi
examples.problem: Gandhi is remembered for teaching…

examples.title: Heroes
examples.problem: Who helps when you are sick at a clinic?

sections.title: Inventions Kids Use
sections.explanation: Inventions are useful new things people created. The telephone helps us talk to faraway family. Computers and tablets help learn and play carefully. Use screens with adult rules and take eye breaks.
points: Telephone / mobile — talk and message with elders’ help
Computer / tablet — learning and drawing apps

examples.problem: Which invention helps you talk to grandparents in another city?

examples.title: Light
examples.problem: What lights a dark room at night?

sections.title: Continents and Oceans (Very Light)
sections.explanation: Earth has big land parts called continents and big water parts called oceans. India is in Asia. Knowing the words continent and ocean is enough at Grade 2 — maps can come later with fun.
points: Ocean = very large salt water area
India is in the continent of Asia

examples.title: Home continent
examples.problem: India is in which continent?

examples.title: Word
examples.problem: A huge water body on Earth is called an…

sections.title: Healthy Food vs Junk Food
sections.explanation: Healthy food gives energy to play and study. Fruits, vegetables, milk, dal and roti are friends. Junk food like too many chips and sweets is only for rare treats — not every day.
points: Healthy: fruits, veggies, milk, nuts (if allowed), dal-rice
Junk: too many candies, chips, fizzy drinks

examples.problem: Better everyday snack: apple or only candy?

examples.title: Drink

sections.title: Books and Reading
sections.explanation: Books are treasures. Reading stories improves language and imagination. Visit the school library, handle books gently and read a little every day with family.
points: Library — borrow and return on time
Do not tear pages; keep books dry
Reading aloud with parents is fun

examples.title: Care
examples.problem: How should you treat a library book?

examples.title: Habit
examples.problem: Why read every day?
steps: Learn new words and enjoy stories

sections.title: Computer Parts (Kid Level)
sections.explanation: A computer is a machine that helps us learn and create. Main parts kids can name: monitor (screen), keyboard, mouse and CPU box. Use computers with adult permission and clean dry hands.
points: CPU — the main box that ‘thinks’ (simple idea)

examples.title: Type
examples.problem: Which part has letter keys?

examples.title: See
examples.problem: Which part shows pictures and words?

sections.title: Days, Months and Time
sections.explanation: There are 7 days in a week and 12 months in a year. Knowing today, yesterday and tomorrow helps school planning. Birthdays and festivals are marked on calendars.

examples.title: Week
examples.problem: How many days in a week?

examples.title: Year
examples.problem: How many months in a year?

sections.title: Colours, Shapes and Senses
sections.explanation: We learn about the world with five senses and by naming colours and shapes. Traffic lights use colours for safety. Shapes appear in wheels, doors and roti!
points: Colours: red, blue, green, yellow, orange, black, white
Senses: see, hear, smell, taste, touch
Traffic light: red stop, yellow wait, green go

examples.title: Shape
examples.problem: A wheel looks like which shape?

examples.title: Sense
examples.problem: Which sense do you use for a school bell?

sections.title: Plants, Weather and Seasons (Light)
sections.explanation: Plants need water, air and sunlight. Weather can be sunny, rainy or windy. India has different seasons — summer can be hot; monsoon brings rain. Dress and play safely for the weather.
points: Do not pluck plants in public parks
Carry umbrella in rain; drink water in summer
